chronology.claim_label: retrospective excluded-source test of a pre-existing representation

reverse_synthesis_risk: explicit tool-conditioned queries mismatch implicit user intent
tool-use supervision omits abstention and clarification behavior

scoring.primary: directional accuracy on prespecified high-confidence comparisons
scoring.best_candidate: balanced average and tool-call targets only
scoring.regressions: score the predicted reverse-synthesis regression against the shared base
scoring.abstention: do not order base, static, and full on the non-tool target where retention and target-aligned supervision compete
scoring.independence_guardrail: The nested metrics provide one source-level test.
